name: Town Guard

source.note: The 2024 Guard, kept under the Vallaki watch's id so the watch's fights use its sprite; any town's guards can use it. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against the book. The engine has it stab with the spear, never throw it.

actions.name: Spear
actions.summary: Jabs with a spear, or throws it up to 60 ft.
actions.text: Melee or ranged attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Piercing damage.

summary: A watchman behind a shield and a chain shirt: hard to hit, but one or two solid blows put him down.
